questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: How children make friends at a new school
Whether making friends with other mums is positive or stressful
How to organise a play date
Why mothers work too hard
questions.why: They ask whether making 'mum friends' is positive or an extra stress for overworked mothers.

questions.q: What does Neil remember about first days at school?
options: He always loved them because he enjoyed meeting new people
He only had one first day
He cried all day
He changed schools a lot, and they were never easy
questions.why: Neil says he changed schools quite a lot, so had lots of first days, 'never easy'.

questions.q: What happened on Beth's first day at school?
options: She cried, but was happy once her mum left, while her mum was sad
She was happy all day, and so was her mum, who went straight to work
She refused to go into the classroom
Her mum stayed with her all day
questions.why: Beth cried at first, but was fine after her mum left, and her mum spent the day sad.

questions.q: What does presenter Nuala McGovern find interesting about the term 'mum friends'?
options: It is used only in Britain
It was invented by a newspaper in the United States
These people are never just called 'friends'
Dads use it more than mums
questions.why: She says, 'they're never called “friends”, they're called “mum friends”'.

questions.q: According to mum Jayne Cherrington-Cook, what are the school gates like?
options: A quiet place where nobody talks
A friendly place where everyone gets on well with each other
A place mostly for dads
Like high school, with separate groups of mums
questions.why: She compares it to a high school clique, with sporty mums and glam mums.

questions.q: What does Jayne find weird about these groups of mums?
options: They all wear the same clothes
They only meet because their children were born in the same year
They never talk about their children and only discuss clothes and make-up
They only meet at weekends
questions.why: She says 'you're all there just because your children were born in the same year'.

questions.q: Why does Jayne mention baby yoga and painting at four months old?
options: To recommend these activities to new mums
To show how talented her baby was
To show why she found baby groups ridiculous
To explain how she met her best friend at a baby yoga class
questions.why: She had bad experiences at these baby groups and thought, 'This is ridiculous!'

questions.q: What does Jayne conclude about making mum friends?
options: It mostly depends on luck
It depends on how hard you try
It's impossible for most mums
It's easy if you join a baby group
questions.why: She realised it was 'just down to luck' if she met somebody she clicked with.
